destination: Chinese course paper and Madrid slides; not a journal submission
export: Editable PDF/SVG and 600dpi PNG; final embedded glyphs >=5pt; final draw panel alignment <=1.5pt; source/PDF glyph/collision audits and visual QA

benchmark.question: How do the 21 tabular entries compare under the new shared nested protocol?
benchmark.panels: Four tasks, both grid and TPE per named entry, all three folds summarized by mean and SD
benchmark.selection: All entries in paper; slides show the first seven grid-ranked nonconstant entries plus constant, using a fixed presentation rule only

ablation.question: Which feature dependencies persist across models and folds?
ablation.panels: Four task-specific matrices; each model/feature-group cell contains three vertical strips for three paired outer-fold changes
ablation.variability: All fold changes retained, not only means; task-specific linear diverging colour scales

architecture.question: Does disabling a neural component worsen held-out performance?
architecture.panels: Five prespecified controls across four tasks, retaining all paired outer-fold changes

neural_training.question: Are errors still changing within the fixed 40-epoch neural budget?
neural_training.panels: Four tasks, training and validation curves for ResMLP and FeatureTransformer, a fixed display choice not ranked by outer scores
neural_training.variability: Three-fold means and SD; curves are diagnostic only, no epoch selection or early stopping

sequence.question: Do sequence models improve on the same available history and persistence reference?

panels.a: All 15 entries, both searches where applicable, mean and SD
panels.b: All 13 fitted entries under five history/field-group ablations, all fold changes

sequence.identity_and_timing: 6,228 eligible three-season windows; hashed composite name/country/draft key is imperfect; all lag sources precede target season; not an independent new cohort

shap.question: How does a fixed boosting reference use the original fields?
shap.panels: Four tasks, all outer validation rows, training-only paths as background, grouped original fields
shap.fixed_model: Expanded HGB grid, chosen before results, not the best model selected after explanation
shap.output: Regression target units after inverse scaling; Adult log odds

fit_diagnostics.question: How do errors change with sample size and tree depth?
fit_diagnostics.panels: Four tasks by learning/complexity controls; 108 auxiliary fits; mean and fold SD
fit_diagnostics.training_fraction: HGB parameters from full outer-training inner CV; preprocessing refit per subset; no outer tuning

local.question: How do original fields combine in one fixed-model prediction?
local.panels: House and Adult median absolute-error record, selected across all outer folds
local.uncertainty: One actual observation per task; not a replicate aggregate

holdout_extension.question: How does the CV-preselected classifier compare on the previously used Adult test?
holdout_extension.panels: All 21 test AUC intervals and fixed-reference paired differences
holdout_extension.uncertainty: 2000 paired fingerprint-group bootstrap samples; 95% percentiles; conditional on fitted models, no multiplicity correction
holdout_extension.selection: CatBoost chosen from CV before test predictions; no test-driven reselection
